facts.fact: The Central Bank of Tunisia published Circular 2026-10 on 2026-09-25 governing payment institutions, repealing Circular 2018-16 and tightening its oversight of their agents and governance, per African Manager.

TUN.note: Circular 2026-10 safeguarding and fee disclosure rules enter into force at the end of December 2026, not yet in force.
Caps on funds received from abroad name no digital channel or corridor.
No government payments to people stated.
No survey share; the BCT gave no account or usage figures.

facts.fact: African Manager says Tunisian payment institutions operate payment accounts at three levels, with balance caps of TND 500, 1,000 and 5,000 under Circular 2018-16, to be raised under Circular 2026-10.

TUN.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
